abstract: 19 of 53 patients (36%) with non-seminomatous testicular cancer, clinical stage I (CS I), had retroperitoneal lymph node metastases, pathological stage II (PS II), demonstrated by retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RLND). RLND was done unilaterally in peroperatively tumor-free patients (PS I: 34 patients; PS II: 3 patients) and bilaterally if metastatic lymph nodes were found peroperatively. Patients with PS II received adjuvant cis-platinum containing combination chemotherapy. Postoperative tumor activity was observed in 3 patients (median observation time: 31 months). They were cured by salvage chemotherapy. 12-18 months after RLND no ejaculatory disturbances were observed in 28 of 36 unilaterally operated patients. After unilateral RLND, 7 patients fathered children. Unilateral RLND seems to be a sufficient diagnostic procedure in patients with non-seminomatous testicular cancer, CS I, who were found tumor-free during the operation. Fertility is preserved in the majority of the unilaterally operated patients.
abstract_ja: 臨床病期I（CS I）の非セミノーマ性精巣がん患者53例のうち19例（36%）に、後腹膜リンパ節郭清（RLND）で病理学的な病期IIに相当する後腹膜リンパ節転移が認められた。術中に腫瘍を認めなかった患者では片側の郭清を行い、術中に転移リンパ節が見つかった場合は両側に郭清した。病理学的な病期IIの患者にはシスプラチンを含む補助化学療法を行った。術後に腫瘍活性を認めた3例（観察期間中央値31か月）は救援化学療法で治癒した。片側RLND後12～18か月で、片側手術を受けた36例中28例に射精障害は認められなかった。片側RLNDの後、7例が父親となった。臨床病期Iで術中に腫瘍が認められなかった患者では、片側RLNDは十分な診断手技と考えられる。片側手術を受けた患者の大半で妊孕性が温存された。
